script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Distribution day count", overlay=false)
win       = input.int(25, "Window (bars)", minval=1, maxval=200)
dropPct   = input.float(0.2, "Minimum close drop (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.1)
expirePct = input.float(5.0, "Stop counting a day after a rise of (%)", minval=0.1, step=0.5)
// a distribution day: a close down at least dropPct percent from the prior close, on more volume than the prior bar
isDist = close <= close[1] * (1 - dropPct / 100) and volume > volume[1]
// the days still counting: a day drops out once any LATER close is expirePct percent above its close
count = 0
for i = 0 to win - 1
    if isDist[i]
        expired = false
        if i > 0
            for j = 0 to i - 1
                if close[j] >= close[i] * (1 + expirePct / 100)
                    expired := true
        if not expired
            count += 1
plot(count, "Distribution days", color=color.red, style=plot.style_stepline)

It ends when a later bar's low is below the low of the bar it started on. script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Follow-through day", overlay=true)
lookback    = input.int(60, "Highest-close lookback (bars)", minval=2)
drawdownPct = input.float(5.0, "Correction: percent below the highest close", minval=0.0, step=0.25)
minDay      = input.int(4, "Earliest day of the attempt", minval=1)
gainPct     = input.float(1.25, "Minimum gain on the day (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.05)
// in a correction: the close is at least drawdownPct percent below the highest close of the lookback (this bar included)
hiClose = ta.highest(close, lookback)
inCorrection = close <= hiClose * (1 - drawdownPct / 100)
// ONE rally attempt at a time, kept across bars: whether it is live, which day of it this is, and the low it started on
var bool  active   = false
var int   dayCount = 0
var float startLow = na
if active
    // the attempt ends when a later bar trades below the low of the bar it started on
    if low < startLow
        active := false
        dayCount := 0
        startLow := na
    else
        dayCount += 1
// it starts on a bar that closes above the prior close while in a correction (a new one may start on the bar the old one ended)
if not active and close > close[1] and inCorrection
    active := true
    dayCount := 1
    startLow := low
// a follow-through day: day minDay or later of a live attempt, up at least gainPct percent on more volume than the prior bar
followThrough = active and dayCount >= minDay and close >= close[1] * (1 + gainPct / 100) and volume > volume[1]
plotshape(followThrough, "Follow-through day", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.green, size=size.small)

Say the word and I'll add it, with a length of your choosing.

cases.words: Predict tomorrow's close with a neural network and plot the forecast.

answer.reply: I can't build a neural network or any trained forecasting model here — formulas only read the bars that have already happened, so there's no way to learn from history and project tomorrow's close. The closest thing I can build is a projection line from the recent trend: a linear regression of the close over the last N bars extended one bar ahead, drawn on the price chart. Say the word (and a length, e.g. 20) and I'll add it.

cases.words: Plot short interest as a percent of float, updated daily.

cases.words: Draw the exact option max pain level for this Friday's expiry.

cases.words: Show the level 2 order book depth as a heatmap behind price.
